candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. Im get fever wey don last for 2 days. Im body temperature na 38.0°C. Im get high risk for malaria. Malaria test no dey available. Im dey get fever, but e no get cough or difficult breathing. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. Im no dey convulse now and dem never see convulsion before. Im no lethargic and im dey conscious. Im fit drink or breastfeed. Im no dey vomit everything. Im body no get rash. Dem no see any identified bacterial cause. Dem no see any obvious cause of fever. E never get measles for past 3 months and dem no see cough for measles. Im eye no red, im nose no dey run, and im neck no stiff.
